articles.desc: Remember the "Wow!" signal? That high-energy radio signature occurred in 1977, when Earth was much "quieter" in the radio band. Signals from satellites, radar and other human technology have crowded out extraterrestrial radio signals, limiting our ability to monitor the heavens for signals like the still-unexplained one received in 1977. articles.title: Curved surfaces reshape active materials, localizing vibrations near defects
articles.desc: Many materials, both living and engineered, are powered from within. articles.desc: Deimos, the smaller and outermost of Mars' two moons, is roughly oval in shape and has a deep depression at its south pole.
